Please note that the ESCAPE estimates for PM10, PM2.5, PM2.5 absorbance and PM coarse are valid up to 400km from the monitoring area, which was in Greater London, but it is unclear how good the estimates are outside this area. All addresses which are more than 400km away from Greater London are not assigned a PM10 estimate concentrations and have missing data (.) instead. Calculated for 2001 based on the closest year for the cohort 1999.
